description: Get the schema of all available fields and their valid band values, with a plain-words description, unit and minimum plan for each. Every field has level: ticker (per-asset snapshot columns for get_search, get_summary) or market (market_* and macro_* regime bands, one row per date, for get_market and as get_search filters matched on the same date). Use this when the user asks 'what fields are available?', 'what bands does momentum_rsi_zone have?', 'what macro bands exist?', or when you need to validate field/band names before calling get_summary with event parameters, get_search with filters, or get_market. Field names follow <group>_<name>[_<unit>]; bands end in a category word (_zone, _trend, _state ...). The response also lists the naming rules and notes that pre-2026-10-31 names are still accepted.
name: get_schema
